test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six horses numbered as A, B, C, D, E and F are participating in a horse race. On the race track horse C is standing between horse A and horse E as its immediate neighbours. Horse D is not standing at any of the extreme ends. Horse B is standing to the immediate right of horse E. Horse F is not standing at the extreme right end. Horse D is standing at fourth to the left of horse B.

If all the horses are facing towards north, which horse is standing at the extreme left end?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Number of horses= 6, namely A, B, C, D, E, F.
 
• All are facing North direction.

**Explanation:**

 
• Horse D is standing at fourth to the left of horse B.
 
• Horse D is not standing at any of the extreme ends.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4088ef37d200da8b0a1a62e26fddd1998e7c9d54e8ccda1d3e52f6f782a0df95.png] ​

 
• Horse B is standing to the immediate right of horse E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/558e51c456984cf337f72fcc73b2edd707de4b3b5abaeb24f0a6d6fc2f5c7c81.png] 

 
• Horse C is standing between horse A and horse E as its immediate neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4fb3a81e8a08df704521bdf0b75bc7f63440279462a656f589f2fef2897f480.png] 

 
• Horse F is not standing at the extreme right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a58c0486da586146ced9ff3e16df5319c2e1fa64f939e93f07d904a9a899c9d.png] 

 
• So, **horse F is standing at the extreme left end.**

Hence,** F **is the** correct answer.**

14
